decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) E-ramp starting ~490–544 with no clear N/U counterpart; (2) coupled E-upward and U-downward trend from ~520–664, possibly indicating subsidence with horizontal extension. No sharp jumps or temporary offsets dominate; trends are gradual but distinct against background noise.

regions.observation: E-component shows a sustained upward ramp from ~index 490 to 544, with increasing slope and superposed noise; N and U show no matching coherent trend, suggesting possible local deformation or systematic bias onset. The ramp begins abruptly near index 490 and continues without plateau through the window end.

U-component exhibits a clear monotonic descent from ~index 520 to 664, accelerating after ~580; E-component rises steadily in parallel, while N remains noisy but roughly centered—suggesting a coupled vertical-horizontal motion. A possible opposing return is ambiguous beyond 664 due to window truncation, but the descent appears persistent through the window.
